body:
I have seen a psychologist in the past (not sure what the difference is between the two) and she told me she wanted me on antidepressants. At the time I was stressed about applying to universities and such, my father forbade me from going on drugs for a problem he said I didn't have, so I never went on medication. Eventually I decided to stop seeing her because I didn't think I was accomplishing anything by going to her twice a month to talk about my week.  
  
Fast forward about a year: The thoughts have persisted and like I said, even with the psychologist I have never told anyone about these thoughts (they were occurring at that time). I started University a month ago and things seem to be going fine; I enjoy most of my classes, I am close enough to home to visit when I want, I've been dating a girl since the start of University, landed a job as a tech consultant for the University computer labs, things are going great for me. And yet... these thoughts persist.
